# `CallableTrialExecutor`

`Rasuvaeff\PropertyTesting\Runner\CallableTrialExecutor`

**Class** — **Package:** [property-testing-core](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/property-testing-core) — [Source](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/property-testing-core/blob/master/src/Runner/CallableTrialExecutor.php#L19) — **Version:** working tree

**Implements:** [`Runner\TrialExecutor`](/api/classes/Runner/TrialExecutor)

The standalone executor: a plain callback is the property body. A normal
return passes, [`Assume`](/api/classes/Assume)::that() discards,
any other throwable fails the trial.

This is what a custom harness (CLI script, application-side checker) uses
with [`Runner\PropertyRunner`](/api/classes/Runner/PropertyRunner) directly, without any test framework.
